routeHint: Administration -> Reports in the sidebar (beside Ask Orgo). ADMIN_TENANT only. This is the state BEFORE any report exists, so it can only be captured while report_definition holds no row for tenant 282 - which is why it is parked at 'keep' after the first run: the three demo reports seeded by capture/seed-reports.mjs make the list non-empty and this spec would then photograph the populated table instead. routeHint: Reports -> New report. Members is the default starting point (Form.vue applyDefaultEntity prefers User), so no chip click is needed. The field groups start collapsed: the first .report-field-group-head is the root group ('Members'), the rest are the to-one relations. Address the group heads by CSS, never by text: the sidebar also carries 'Members', and the relation groups are labelled with the schema's long descriptions. Field labels come from GET /report_schema and are the descriptions too ('Date user joined the organization'). The preview never runs on its own - it loads only when Run preview is pressed - so the last action before the shot must be that button, and the waitFor must be a rendered preview row rather than the panel. Tick a checkbox by clicking its .control-label span, not the .report-field-option label: Playwright's :text-is() matches only the SMALLEST element holding the text, so `.report-field-option:text-is("Email")` matches nothing and every tick is silently skipped (it cost one capture of an empty builder). Framing: the click on Run preview scrolls the pane down by ~275px, which is deliberate - at 1290 high the report name field and the preview rows cannot both be in frame (the builder is ~1900px tall), and the ticked columns plus real rows are what this image is for; the name field is visible in reports-field-groups and reports-filters instead. 'tall' fits the whole builder but drops the sidebar and leaves ~600px of empty canvas, and a selector crop to .report-builder tears (the element is taller than the viewport and the app scrolls an inner pane, so Playwright stitches the app header into the top and cuts the right edge). REWRITTEN 2026-11-11 for the redesigned two-pane builder. The entity is a dropdown (.report-entity-trigger opens it, .report-entity-option picks one), the root entity's own fields are the FIRST .report-field-group and carry no label, relation groups are the labelled ones after it, field labels are Title Case, and Columns and Filters are sections of one rail rather than tabs. Save is .report-builder-save. The three demo reports were rebuilt through the UI by capture/seed-reports.mjs on 2026-11-11 after report_definition was found empty. This shot deliberately does NOT save: the builder has no upsert, so a saving capture would add a duplicate report on every run. Two selector traps in the Columns rail: the option is a Buefy <label> whose text node is preceded by an HTML comment, so :text-is() never matches it and :has-text() must be used; and :has-text() is a substring, so 'Date Joined' matches 'Date Joined Full Member' too and clicking it fails on strict mode. Tick Phone Number instead. Scope every option to .report-field-group.is-root: the collapsed relation groups keep their options in the DOM.

notes: The preview count reads 'showing 10 of 10' for a report matching 382 members. That is the product, not a bad capture: ReportPreviewController forces limit=10, and QueryCompiler::execute() collapses totalCount to the number of returned rows whenever the limit differs from the default 50 (the 'top N' rule inherited from Ask Orgo). Do not re-capture chasing a real total.
